mapper.update: UPDATE `goal` SET goal_name = #{objectName}, target_amount = #{targetAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, isa_rate = #{isaRate}, deposit_rate = #{depositRate}, start_amount = #{startAmount}, goal_rate = #{goalRate} WHERE goal_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} /*goal.getGoaldID*/
mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_id, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE goal_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_name, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY goal_id DESC
mapper.delete: delete from `goal` where goal_id = #{objectId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM daily_goal_progress WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} ORDER BY progress_date ASC

SELECT a.bank_code AS bankCode, a.account_balance AS accountBalance, act.account_allocated_rate AS allocatedRate FROM action act JOIN account a ON act.account_id = a.account_id WHERE act.goal_id = #{goalId} AND act.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0
